mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees with moderate rain outside City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city is preparing for road surface treatments starting August 4th, so look for no-parking signs. Also, residents can apply for a 100 dollar rebate when replacing old toilets with high-efficiency models.
There is a lot going on today, including the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus on August 4th.
In a noteworthy call from July 26th, an 83-year-old driver was cited for a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Today's featured flavor is the Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but they will reopen at 10 AM for you to stop by and grab a scoop.
